releaseNotesMarkdown:
### VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics (victoriametrics/vmalert)

### [`v1.156.0`](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.156.0)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/compare/v1.155.0...v1.156.0)

#### [v1.156.0](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/releases/tag/v1.156.0)

Released at 2026-11-09

- FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics [Enterprise](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/) components: run with the `-eula` command-line flag to accept [ESA](https://victoriametrics.com/legal/esa/). License keys are no longer verified. The `-license`, `-licenseFile`, `-licenseFile.reloadInterval` and `-license.forceOffline` flags are deprecated and are treated as `-eula`, so existing setups keep working. See [Running VictoriaMetrics Enterprise](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/enterprise/#running-victoriametrics-enterprise).

- FEATURE: all VictoriaMetrics components: add new metric `process_cgroup_cpu_throttled_seconds_total` which exposes CPU throttling. See [#​10430](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/10430).

- FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/) and [Single-node VictoriaMetrics](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/): support `authentication_method: WorkloadIdentity` in [azure_sd_configs](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/sd_configs/#azure_sd_configs). It allows discovering Azure VMs from Kubernetes clusters with [workload identity federation](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/workload-id/workload-identity-federation) without a static client secret. See [#​11558](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11558). Thanks to [@​banlor](https://redirect.github.com/banlor) for contribution.

- FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): add a new flag `-remoteWrite.queuePath`, which allows configuring [persistent-queue](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/#on-disk-persistence) path for each `-remoteWrite.url` independently. See [#​11662](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11662).

- FEATURE: [vmagent](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmagent/): add `vmagent_kafka_consumer_rebalance_events_total` and `vmagent_kafka_consumer_assigned_partitions` metrics for monitoring partition rebalancing and distribution. See [partition distribution](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/integrations/kafka/#partition-distribution) and [#​11370](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11370).

- FEATURE: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): add `-notifier.sanitizeLabelNames` command-line flag. Set it to `false` to send alert label names to notifiers without replacing characters outside `[a-zA-Z0-9_:]` with underscores. This is useful for Alertmanager v0.27.0 or newer, which [supports UTF-8 label names](https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/#utf-8-strict-mode) when not running in classic mode. See [#​11629](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11629).

- FEATURE: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/), `vmstorage` and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): expose the working-set cache mode via `vm_cache_mode` for `storage/tsid`, `storage/metricIDs`, `storage/metricName`, `indexdb/tagFiltersLoops`, and `promql/rollupResult` cache. Values are `0` for split, `1` for switching, and `2` for whole. This metric helps users understand the internal memory and cache mechanisms. See [#​11860](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11860).

- BUGFIX: all VictoriaMetrics components: OS `solaris` fixes compilation error. See [#​11850](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11850). Thanks to [@​szaydel](https://redirect.github.com/szaydel) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: all VictoriaMetrics components: correctly detect `CPU` and `memory` `cgroup` limits configured via [systemd slices](https://www.freedesktop.org/software/systemd/man/latest/systemd.slice.html) in `cgroup v1`. Previously, only the global host cgroup limit was used, which could cause OOM errors and CPU throttling. See [#​11827](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11827).

- BUGFIX: [alerts](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules): stop [vmbackupmanager alerting rules](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/blob/master/deployment/docker/rules/alerts-vmbackupmanager.yml) `NoLatestBackupWithinLastDay`, `NoHourlyBackupWithinLastDay`, `NoDailyBackupWithinLast3Days`, `NoWeeklyBackupWithinLast14Days` and `NoMonthlyBackupWithinLast62Days` from firing when scheduled backups are disabled via `-disableScheduledBackups` or the corresponding backup type is disabled via `-disableHourly`, `-disableDaily`, `-disableWeekly` or `-disableMonthly`. See [#​11543](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11543).

- BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): properly delay flushes after a sudden ingestion lag spike when [aggregation windows](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#aggregation-windows) are enabled. Previously, a data gap or a restart could reduce the tolerance for delayed samples to the aggregation interval, resulting in more dropped samples than necessary. See [#​11866](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11866).

- BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): prevent skipping aggregation and deduplication flushes when [aggregation windows](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/#aggregation-windows) are enabled and incoming samples are delayed by one interval or more, e.g. when the ingestion pipeline is overloaded. Previously, the flush delay could grow with the sample lag, causing skipped flushes and gaps in the results. Now the flush delay is capped at 90% of the aggregation or deduplication interval. See [#​11811](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11811).

- BUGFIX: [stream aggregation](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/stream-aggregation/): prevent spikes in `rate_sum` and `rate_avg` outputs with `enable_windows: true` when out-of-order samples arrive around the aggregation window boundary. Previously, an out-of-order sample could be treated as a counter reset, causing large spike in the result. See [#​11810](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11810).

- BUGFIX: [vmalert](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/vmalert/): send staleness markers for recording rule series with their original labels when a label value contains `,` or `=`, and avoid reporting distinct label sets as duplicates when these symbols occur in label values. Previously, staleness markers could be sent with broken labels and distinct label sets could collide in the series key. See [#​11851](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11851). Thanks to [@​sarankumar1325](https://redirect.github.com/sarankumar1325) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly calculate [running_avg](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/metricsql/#running_avg) and [range_avg](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/metricsql/#range_avg) for series with `NaN` points in the middle. Previously, every `NaN` point was counted in the divisor, so each value after the gap moved the result by less than it should. See [#​11823](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11823). Thanks to [@​spicysharkco](https://redirect.github.com/spicysharkco) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): do not increase `vm_http_request_errors_total` when a query is cancelled. This prevents false `RequestErrorsToAPI` alerts from firing. See [#​11828](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11828).

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly parse `metricsql` expression numbers with leading zeroes, such as `09` or `08`. See [#​11621](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11621). Thanks to [@​andriibeee](https://redirect.github.com/andriibeee) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): properly check `-search.maxPointsSubqueryPerTimeseries` limit for [subqueries](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/metricsql/#subqueries). Previously it could cause runtime panic. See [#​11862](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11862).

- BUGFIX: [vmsingle](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/) and `vmselect` in [VictoriaMetrics cluster](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/cluster-victoriametrics/): correctly cancel query request if `-search.skipSlowReplicas` flag is set. See [#​11771](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11771) for details.

- BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): fixes predefined dashboard rows not expanding when clicking the row title. See [#​11829](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/issues/11829). Thanks to [@​nikshrma](https://redirect.github.com/nikshrma) for contribution.

- BUGFIX: [vmui](https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victoriametrics/single-server-victoriametrics/#vmui): support label names with special characters in series aliases. See [#​11822](https://redirect.github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/pull/11822). Thanks to [@​kema-dev](https://redirect.github.com/kema-dev) for contribution.
